A LITTLE FRIENDLY AMBITION

Find your next challenge.

Find your rhythm, race the horizon, or build a drift streak. Solo challenges use your current scenery and weather. Pause whenever you need a breath.

01 / AGAINST THE CLOCK

Horizon Sprint

750 metres. 90 seconds. Find your line through the bends and reach the horizon before time runs out.

02 / FIND YOUR FLOW

Clean Cruise

60 seconds of smooth driving. Stay on the road above 30 km/h. Longer clean streaks multiply your points.

03 / CONTROL THE SLIDE

Drift Flow

60 seconds. Enter a bend, tap the handbrake, countersteer and catch the slide. Stay on the road to score.

Manual driving only. Reset ends the attempt. Escape or × closes this menu.

A LITTLE COMPANY

Wander together.

Shared drives keep cars ghosted. Race rooms enable car contact and a synchronized 1500-metre sprint. Invite friends before the host starts. Casual racing; no anti-cheat.
